## Verified resolution

Fixed in local ES commit `1d5397fda9d7c5c2a4c7f9390ef49b9bb4b879ce`, included in clean qualified final source `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. [Published source-overlay evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) provides rejected/original and corrected frames, exact source/build/catalog hashes, passing checks, independent review and canonical CF01–CF15 references. #508 now explicitly tracks this exact source for integration and pin promotion; its body was read back before this closure. This closes the verified draft-source defect, not the parent integration/firmware/public-adoption gate. Accepted firmware and the installed handheld remain unchanged.

## Observed defect

Independent review of #508/#510 source found three player-visible protocol reasons absent from EmulationStation CloudText::whySentences and the French catalog: `YOUR CLOUD SETTINGS CHANGED. CHECK AGAIN`, `ANOTHER CLOUD CHECK IS RUNNING`, and `YOUR CLOUD FOLDERS COULDN'T BE CREATED`. The localizedWhy fallback has no French translation for these reasons, but actual display also depends on outcome routing. A real French busy-scan frame shows the existing sync-specific skipped headline instead of this reason: it incorrectly describes another check as synchronization. The narrow fix includes Scan+75 check-specific wording; actual changed-config/create failure captures will establish their rendering. Source: ES baeea2a8c9bf508949104abcf04583a2338e054f, distribution6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30. This was caught while applying the required flow/screenshot protocol D-WORKFLOW-156.

Already written: these draft scripts and ES changes remain local/unintegrated. Existing accepted firmware and personal clouds are unchanged; this is a draft UI translation defect, not a data migration.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Synthetic provider/configuration/lock failures on the current disposable GENERIC_X64 guest expose the actual failure surfaces. No physical action or personal cloud is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Exact source trace and actual failing French frames retain the observed behavior: check-busy mislabeled as sync, plus actual changed-config/create rendering; do not infer raw-English display solely from table omission.
- [x] All three reasons use the established localized reason table and complete French catalog; Scan+75 describes another check while ordinary sync75 behavior is preserved; focused catalog/unit checks cite exact committed source and result.
- [x] Actual affected French failure frames pass review with source/binary/locale/panel hashes in the #510 evidence index; canonical flow rows link them. Existing unaffected evidence keeps explicit provenance.
- [x] The final qualified ES source is included in #508 integration/pin tracking; close only with that commit/evidence readback.

Source/proof ownership completed and released; root owns the remaining #508 integration and M7 tracking. Keep full host/ordinary VM regressions accepted for unchanged distribution source. This is within #508 qualification before #507 independent review, not a new unrelated release phase.
